notes_fix.why: Chauri Chaura toll is 22 policemen in standard accounts

patterns: APPSC asks single facts with an Andhra lens: Bezawada AICC year (1921), Kanneganti Hanumanthu's birth district (Guntur).
Palnadu Pullari satyagraha (1921-22, first forest satyagraha in Andhra) is the recurring anchor.
Titles of Andhra leaders (Andhra Kesari, Desabhakta, Andhra Ratna, Desoddharaka) are classic match items.
App has almost nothing on the Home Rule Movement in Andhra (Besant's leagues, Andhra branches) despite the topic title; app items are more multi-statement than PYQs.
